map.通过外观性状指标评估中药饮片质量等级，内置常见药材标准: Evaluates the quality grade of Chinese herb pieces through appearance indicators, with built-in standards for common herbs
map.观察药材的形状、大小、表面特征、色泽。如黄连断面金黄、党参断面菊花心、天麻表面有: Observe the shape, size, surface features and color of the herb. For example coptis has golden yellow fracture surfaces, codonopsis shows a chrysanthemum-core pattern, and gastrodia has vertical wrinkles and nodes on the surface.
map.感受药材的质地。如质坚（矿物类）、质柔（肉苁蓉）、质脆（干姜）、粉性（山药）、角: Feel the texture of the herb. For example firm (minerals), soft (cistanche), brittle (dried ginger), powdery (chinese yam) and horny (gastrodia).
map.闻药材的气味。如麝香特异香气、当归浓郁芳香、阿魏蒜臭气、腥气（动物类）。: Smell the odor of the herb. For example musk has a characteristic aroma, angelica is strongly fragrant, asafoetida smells of garlic, and animal materials smell fishy.
map.品尝药材的味道。如黄连极苦、甘草甜、乌梅酸、干姜辛辣。注意有毒药材勿尝。: Taste the herb. For example coptis is extremely bitter, licorice is sweet, smoked plum is sour and dried ginger is pungent. Note that toxic herbs must not be tasted.
map.西红花入水水染成金黄色、熊胆入水旋转如线。: Safflower turns water golden yellow and bear bile rotates in water like a thread.
map.海金沙点火爆鸣、麝香灼烧膨胀冒泡。: Lygodium spores crackle when heated and musk swells and bubbles when burned.

map.外观40×0.3 + 色泽30×0.25 + 断面25×0.25 + 气味15×: Appearance 40x0.3 + color 30x0.25 + fracture 25x0.25 + odor 15x0.2 = 12 + 7.5 + 6.25 + 3 = 28.75 (80 or above excellent, 60-80 good, 40-60 fair, below 40 poor); when the total 31 giving below 40 as poor disagrees with the weighted 287/1000, use the total 28.75; recheck is recommended.
map.c.weight 权重占比合计 100%；典型外观 25-35, 色泽 20-3: c.weight weights total 100%; typical appearance 25-35, color 20-30, fracture 15-25, odor 10-20, texture 10-20; total = sum(s_i x w_i / 100) comes from qualityDB itself.
map.为何用权重而非总分？: Why use weights instead of a simple total?
map.不同维度重要性不同（外观色泽比气味更重要），加权可避免「以一项差掩盖整体优」或「: The dimensions differ in importance (appearance and color matter more than odor), and weighting avoids the bias where one poor item masks overall excellence or one good item hides several poor ones, which is closer to how experienced pharmacists score.
map.霉变还能用吗？: Can moldy herbs still be used?
map.不能。霉变不仅有效成分下降，更可能产生黄曲霉毒素等有害物质，且肉眼可见霉斑时菌丝: No. Mold not only lowers active components, it is more likely to produce harmful substances such as aflatoxin, and when mold spots are visible to the naked eye the mycelium has usually already penetrated deep inside; washing, drying or soaking in wine cannot remove the toxins. Likewise, severely insect-damaged herbs (powdery fracture, insect droppings), oil-spotted herbs (oily or sugary herbs turning soft and sticky with a rancid smell) and discolored herbs with a sour rancid odor should all be judged non-conforming and no longer used medicinally.
